answer: The panel asks first about the ocean, then about the voyage, then about the comet, and it hears all three out before it answers. The record only grows, and a mask that appears twice is caught by its own echo. Two separate readers reaching the same answer is the whole of the check. Renewal charges 224 POA every epoch, so the farm's 385 masks bleed 86240 POA again next epoch. Proof, not pledges: Court hand diploma sheet mark lettered across the chancery office asks for each diploma sheet is a measured sheet yield plus a calligrapher signature, and a farm has no honest way to provide it.
